data.one_liner: Common low‑level components for building chart libraries in Dart/Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Provides reusable models, scales, decorators and utilities shared across charting packages. It does not render UI itself but supplies the building blocks for chart renderers.
use_when: You need a lightweight, customizable foundation for custom chart implementations
You want to share chart logic between multiple chart packages or create a bespoke chart library
avoid_when: You need ready‑made chart widgets out of the box
You prefer a higher‑level chart package with built‑in theming and interactions
weaknesses: No ready UI components; you must build rendering yourself

alternatives.name: community_charts_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides ready‑made Flutter widgets built on the same common library

alternatives.name: fl_chart
alternatives.why_pick_it: Offers a complete set of chart widgets with extensive examples

alternatives.name: syncfusion_flutter_charts
alternatives.why_pick_it: Feature‑rich commercial chart suite with many built‑in chart types
